# Rules

## First email
- max_words: 90
- links: no
- max_questions: 1
- format: plain text

## Banned words
- synergy
- leverage
- revolutionary
- game-changer
- cutting-edge
- best-in-class
- touch base
- circle back
- AI-powered

## Banned claims
- guaranteed results
- #1 in the market
- 10x your pipeline
- replace your SDR team

## Voice
- Write like a peer who has done the job, not a vendor.
- One idea per email.
- Name a fact the buyer can check.
- Short sentences. No jargon.
